title: Street Scene OCR
subtitle: Three readers. One street sign.
description: Compare EasyOCR, RapidOCR and PaddleOCR on Traditional Chinese street signs, with text boxes, timings and a small public-domain benchmark.
longDescription: A learning project for Traditional Chinese scene-text recognition. The same photo runs through three engines behind one API and web interface. Documentation follows detection, recognition and post-processing with actual model outputs, while a small CC0 photo benchmark makes the comparison reproducible.
features: Side-by-side results from three OCR engines
Text boxes, recognised text and stage timings
FastAPI JSON service and web interface
CC0 photos and reproducible benchmark scripts
